qualification: Sequential local Zig 0.17.0 Debug runs on a shared host. Both executables include the same main revision. No build, E2E or cache cleanup from this task overlaps measured queries. Restarts retain OS/persistent caches and readiness warming. No isolated causal, Release, empty-cache, real-provider or full-archive latency claim.

exact_comparisons.totals_oracle: Source/cover totals must be exact at 256. Phrase totals are independently checked against 64 matches: exact=64 or a valid lower bound between delivered hits and 64. Plan-dependent exact/gte precision may differ.

notes: The same-main control uses the pre-refinement merge commit and reversible production-source overrides; its embedded build metadata reports the later worktree revision/dirty overlay. All overrides and the final installed executable were restored before measurement.

The source E2E and benchmark project deterministic incompressible 4 KiB values spanning native transport blocks. Component hint bytes and work counts are distinct from total query memory and physical provider traffic.
Real-provider qualification remains deferred. Slower timing controls and all application retry attempts are retained.
interpretation: The initial mixed projection/source timings are close and do not establish an additional large end-to-end latency gain. The analyzed match_phrase control already selects text postings in both executables; its timings do not qualify the new ordered phrase cost decision. Structural cache reuse and bounded source hints are proven separately.
